# Al-Kahf Day Checklist: Al-Kahf Reminder Day

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements for the choice of the al-Kahf reminder day (the setting and its default, the planning rule and ids, the notification, the Settings control, looks and accessibility, backup and upgrade, strings, regression safety, test coverage) before tasks are written.
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## The setting and its default

- [ ] CHK001 Is the set of values closed at exactly two (Thursday, Friday), with "both days" and other weekdays stated as out of scope rather than left implicit? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the default (Thursday) tied to "today's behaviour" in one place and used the same way in the spec, the data model and the contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Data Model The setting]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the read rule for a missing value and for an unknown value one rule, not two different ones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Research D1]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the relation of the day, the hour and the switch stated for each pair of changes (day then hour, hour then day, off then on), including which of them ever "chooses" an hour and what the default hour is for each day? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications, §FR-014, Data Model State transitions]

## Planning rule and ids

- [ ] CHK005 Is "Thursday" and "Friday" defined as the phone's local weekday, with the decision not to compute the Islamic day from sunset written down? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the rule for a day whose hour has already passed written for both days with one example each (today, tomorrow, next week)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the maximum number of al-Kahf notifications in a plan (two in 14 days) and the "one weekday only" rule measurable? [Measurability, Data Model The plan rule, Spec SC-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "ids unique for each day of the planned period" reconciled with the existing id scheme and with `isKahf`, including why no second id base is needed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Research D2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the replacement of the old day's waiting notifications specified, and the fate of a notification already in the tray stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the behaviour at the instant of a change on the day itself (Thursday evening to Friday, Friday night to Thursday) specified in both directions? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## The notification

- [ ] CHK011 Is the Thursday notification required to be byte-for-byte today's (title, body, payload, id), so a regression can be told from a change? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the Friday body fixed as one exact string and marked as a proposal, with the title unchanged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the tap target stated for both days (page 293, browse mode), including a tap on a notification that started the app? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the effect of the day on the notification channel (name only, same id) written so an existing install keeps its channel settings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Research D7]

## The Settings control

- [ ] CHK015 Is the position of the choice (under the switch, above the hour row) and its visibility rule (only while the switch is on) stated once and the same in the spec and in contracts/ui.md? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Contracts ui.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the saved day required to be kept, not reset, while the switch is off? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, Data Model State transitions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "saves at once, no button" defined with what the user sees (selection mark moves in the same frame) and what the phone does (a replan after the scheduler's pause)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the texts of the switch's title and subtitle specified for both days, with Thursday's required to equal the current strings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the case of notifications not allowed by the phone specified for the choice (it still works and saves)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Looks, size and accessibility

- [ ] CHK020 Is "marked by more than colour" defined with the marks used (outline weight and a check icon), not only as a principle? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contracts ui.md The choice]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the contrast, 48 px and 320 dp / 2x requirements stated with the same numbers as the looks of feature 004 and the sizes of feature 003? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the stacking rule for a narrow window or a large font a measurable condition, and is the one-line fit of the card labels addressed? [Clarity, Contracts ui.md The choice, Research D6]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the screen reader requirements complete for the group name, each option (button, label, selected) and the change of selection? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK024 Are right-to-left order and the choice's reading order (Thursday first) stated? [Gap, Contracts ui.md]

## Backup and upgrade

- [ ] CHK025 Is it stated that the day travels as an ordinary setting, that the file version does not change, and that no key validation is added? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Research D10]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the four backup cases (Friday, Thursday never set, an older file without the key, an unknown value) each a written requirement with an expected day? [Coverage, Spec User Story 2, User Story 3, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the replan after an import specified, so a restored Friday does not keep a Thursday schedule? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Research D10]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the upgrade case (an installed app with the old settings and no day) specified as "no visible change"? [Completeness, Spec User Story 2, SC-002]

## Strings and Arabic

- [ ] CHK029 Is every new Arabic string listed once with its status (proposal or today's), and is "one file" stated as a requirement with a place to confirm them? [Traceability, Spec §FR-013, Assumptions, Contracts dart-interfaces.md]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the open questions for the owner (the hour on Friday, the Friday body, the labels, the switch texts, one day or both) written as questions, each saying what changes with the answer? [Completeness, Research D8]

## Regression safety and scope

- [ ] CHK031 Is "every existing test passes without any edit" stated as a requirement and named per area (reminders, settings, backup, reader)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the things not changed named (default hour, horizon, permission card, hour picker, wird reminders, background refresh, backup screens), so a reviewer can check the list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the shared-tree coordination (files other sessions edit) recorded outside the spec, in the plan or research, without leaking into the requirements? [Dependency, Research D9]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the part that tests cannot prove (a real notification on a Thursday and on a Friday with the screen locked) written as an owner's check with steps? [Coverage, Spec SC-006, Quickstart]
- [ ] CHK035 Is it clear that no Quran text, no page and no reader behaviour change, so the constitution's Principles I and II are met by absence? [Consistency, Plan Constitution Check]
